sql: SELECT p.id AS property, ROUND(AVG(JULIANDAY(b.check_in) - JULIANDAY(SUBSTRING(b.booked_at, 1, 10))), 1) AS avg_lead_time_days FROM bookings AS b JOIN properties AS p ON p.id = b.property_id WHERE b.status <> 'cancelled' GROUP BY p.id ORDER BY p.id LIMIT 500
answer: The average lead time between booking and check-in is 45.5 days at the beach resort and 45.3 days at the mountain lodge.

sql: SELECT ROUND(1.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN channel = 'direct' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 4) AS direct_share FROM bookings LIMIT 500
answer: The direct channel accounted for a share of 0.3421 (about 34.2%) of all bookings.

sql: SELECT r.room_type, COUNT(*) AS room_count FROM rooms AS r JOIN properties AS p ON r.property_id = p.id WHERE p.name LIKE '%Beach Resort%' OR p.id = 'beach-resort' GROUP BY r.room_type ORDER BY r.room_type LIMIT 500

sql: SELECT r.room_type AS room_type, SUM(b.total_usd) AS revenue_usd FROM bookings AS b JOIN rooms AS r ON r.id = b.room_id WHERE b.property_id = 'beach-resort' AND b.status <> 'cancelled' AND b.check_in BETWEEN '2026-10-01' AND '2026-10-31' GROUP BY r.room_type ORDER BY revenue_usd DESC LIMIT 500
answer: In October 2026, Beach Resort earned $133,393 from Ocean King rooms, $122,923 from Garden Queen rooms, and $77,900 from Suites.

sql: SELECT f.score AS score, COUNT(*) AS feedback_count FROM feedback AS f JOIN bookings AS b ON f.booking_id = b.id JOIN properties AS p ON b.property_id = p.id WHERE p.id = 'mountain-lodge' GROUP BY f.score ORDER BY f.score LIMIT 500

sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS refund_count FROM refunds WHERE amount_usd > 200 LIMIT 500

sql: SELECT CAST(COUNT(b.id) AS REAL) / p.rooms_count AS occupancy FROM properties AS p LEFT JOIN bookings AS b ON b.property_id = p.id AND b.status <> 'cancelled' AND b.check_in <= '2026-03-12' AND b.check_out > '2026-03-12' WHERE p.id = 'mountain-lodge' GROUP BY p.rooms_count LIMIT 500
